description: Returns the authenticated user's time log entries for a date range. Use when the user asks 'how many hours have I worked?', 'show me my timesheet', or 'what did I work on yesterday?'. Cannot query another person's timesheet — use summarize_team_hours for team-level hours.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days ago.

name: list_my_timesheet

total_hours.description: Total hours in the date range

title: My Timesheet
